name: net_session_config_dialog_on_init_dialog
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::OnInitDialog initializes the multiplayer session setup dialog controls and default values. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja reconstructs the SendMessageA import through an ebx-loaded indirect call; the rebuilt source spells these as direct SendMessageA calls.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41ca30 shows CDialog::OnInitDialog, session-name Format("Exercise %03d"), seven map-name CB_ADDSTRING/CB_SETITEMDATA pairs, CB_SETCURSEL, spin range setup, modem-dependent max-player range, default value fields, UpdateData(FALSE), and max-player label text from zLoc message 12353.

The native smoke patches MFC/provider calls, initializes the map-name CString array, verifies both normal and modem max-player spin ranges, checks all map combo messages and item data, validates default dialog fields, and confirms UpdateData and SetDlgItemTextA behavior.
